about_the_game:
📦 ARROW WORLD A Logic Puzzle Game About Cardboard Boxes Living in a Logistics Warehouse

Cardboard as the Main Character? In 'ARROW WORLD', you become a warehouse designer, guiding moving cardboard boxes called "Hakoby" to collect ordered items and reach the goal. They never stop moving! Guide these constantly moving cardboard boxes to the goal by skillfully placing conveyor belts!

🎯 Simple Yet Deep

The controls are easy. Just change the direction of conveyors and place them. But Hakoby never stops moving, so if you make one placement mistake... they'll get lost in no time.

🔄 Infinite Possibilities

Conveyors can be placed infinitely! This creates diverse solutions. Go for the shortest route, or create a safe detour. Build your own perfect logistics system.

⚡ Non-Stop Thrills

Unlike other warehouse puzzle games, this one's different! Since Hakoby keeps moving constantly, you need to make real-time decisions while adjusting routes. Sometimes the conveyors you placed become your enemy, causing unexpected troubles...

📦 Adorable Cardboard World

Set in the world of Hakoby moving around a logistics warehouse, a puzzle experience awaits where you can fully utilize logical thinking and creativity.

Will you become an excellent warehouse designer? Or will you become a troubled manager who gets the cardboard boxes lost?
